scope: Read-only verification of current public official PLOS ONE author requirements; no journal login, submission, author assertion, institutional determination, or scientific experiment.
submission_state: NOT_VERIFIED_IN_THIS_REVIEW; distinguish a new submission, author-prepared update to an in-process paper, and editor-invited revision.

requirements: Initial submissions are format-free until provisional Editorial Accept. Publication formatting targets below remain useful for preparing a complete package.
Prepare funding, competing interests, data availability, author information/contributions, corresponding-author ORCID, and applicable reporting materials.
Publication-format manuscript: DOC/DOCX/RTF; LaTeX submission PDF. English, single column, double spaced, continuous line numbers and page numbers, maximum three heading levels, no footnotes.
Full title <=250 characters, short title <=100; abstract <=300 words without citations.
Title page, abstract, introduction, methods/results/discussion, acknowledgments/references/supporting captions; one-page separate cover letter.
Vancouver references: first-citation numbering, bracketed citations, first six authors then et al.; full DOI and standard journal abbreviations.
Place captions and editable tables after first citation; separate figure files. Supporting items have S-number labels and captions at manuscript end; each supporting file <20 MB.
Statistical methods: software/version, design, exclusions, sample size, tests, multiplicity, uncertainty. Results: denominators, effect sizes/CIs and exact p values >=0.001.
Funding information belongs in the online financial disclosure, not manuscript acknowledgments.
If ethics approval was not obtained, give detailed reasons; avoid claiming an exemption or committee decision without evidence.
Publication figure specifications: TIFF or EPS, 300-600 dpi; width 6.68-19.05 cm, maximum height 22.23 cm; <=10 MB.
Arial, Times or Symbol at 8-12 pt; multi-panel figures combined in one file; captions outside image; Fig1.tif/Fig2.eps filenames match citations.
Preserve quantitative content and avoid image changes that distort interpretation; retain source data.
Main tables must be editable cell-based objects in manuscript, not images or separate uploads.
Numeric first-citation order; brief label/title above and notes below; black text; no text boxes or graphics inside cells.
Provide a Data Availability Statement at submission. The minimal dataset comprises the observations, metadata and methods needed to reproduce every reported finding, including plotted values.
Provide stable public repositories or supporting files; do not rely on data not shown.
For third-party data, name and cite original datasets, access routes and applicable restrictions/permissions. Author permission does not override provider rights.
Already-public original EEG can remain at its lawful original repository; analysis-specific reusable derivatives and figure/table data should be available as rights permit.
An author alone must not be the sole data-access gatekeeper.
Author-generated code underpinning findings should be publicly available without restrictions upon publication, reusable and documented.
Prefer persistent repository identifiers and clear open-source licenses; GitHub is listed as an acceptable archive.
Link exact code version from manuscript; provide dependencies, installation/run instructions and relevant settings/test data. Do not invent a DOI before archive issuance.
Policy covers human participants, specimens and data unless exempt under applicable regulations; original ethics/consent provenance should be reported.
Do not fabricate approval numbers, institution determinations or consent waivers. Explain actual secondary-use context and why author states new approval was unnecessary.
Complete applicable human-participants checklist if requested. Mere availability of public data does not by itself establish a formal institutional exemption.
Disclose substantive AI support for submission content or reported research. Identify tools, actual scope/affected materials, and how validity of outputs was evaluated.
Place disclosure in Methods, Acknowledgments or relevant figure legends; AI-assisted figure preparation also requires figure-legend disclosure.

Analysis-script/software generation requires disclosure. Language-only spelling/grammar/clarity edits do not require disclosure under current FAQ; translation disclosure recommended. Cover-letter AI use need not be disclosed.
Tool names are explicitly required; exact historical model versions are not explicitly required on this page. Do not invent them.
AI cannot be an author. Author remains accountable for accurate content, references, methodology and interpretations. Do not narrow a real code/analysis/figure contribution to only grammar.
Technical quality, adequate reporting, research ethics and data-supported conclusions determine suitability. Negative/null findings are explicitly eligible.
Unsupported overstatement is a rejection risk; perceived impact does not justify exaggeration or omission of a finding that changes the conclusion.
No simultaneous consideration elsewhere. Preprints/GitHub public drafts do not themselves establish peer-reviewed prior publication.
An editor-invited revision needs point-by-point response to reviewers/editors, marked-up manuscript, and clean manuscript.
Original figures/supporting files carry forward unless replaced; check the actual existing submission before replacing.
Do not manufacture reviewer comments, decision letters, manuscript numbers or revision invitations.

minimal_package_new_submission: Clean English manuscript with title page and editable tables/captions
Separate figures and numbered supporting files
Data/code availability statement with real repositories/version identifiers
Funding, competing interests, CRediT, author/ORCID and ethical-use statements consistent with source evidence
AI disclosure matching actual substantive assistance
additional_package_only_if_editor_invite: Real point-by-point response linked to actual decision comments
editorial_application_to_current_request: Make contribution statements concrete and positive, with endpoints and comparator conditions attached.
Keep material adverse/null results and uncertainty where needed to interpret primary claims; consolidate repetitive caveats instead of deleting them.
No promise to lower an AI detector percentage; improve specificity, natural prose and traceable evidence while preserving required disclosure.
Document any secondary analysis of frozen outputs as post hoc/exploratory unless a prespecified protocol establishes otherwise.
No new fit, target inference or scientific-rule change is authorized by this policy review.
